units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:6">Keth. IV, 6</cite> <he>זה מ׳ דרש וכ׳</he> the following interpretation did R … teach &c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 6:6">Shek. VI, 6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 15:3:3">Y. Yeb. XV, 14ᵈ</cite> <he>עבדין כתובה מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K01350"><he>כְּתוּבָּה</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:17">Ab. I, 17</cite> <he>לא המ׳ הוא העיקר וכ׳</he> not study is the main thing, but practice is.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 49a:14">Kidd. 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>משנה … אומר מ׳</he> by Mishnah …, R. Judah says, we understand textual interpretation (as Sifra, Sifré &c.), contrad. to <cite ref="E00567"><he>הלכות</he></cite>.
Ib.ᵇ מאי תורה מִדְרַשׁ תורה (R. Johanan means) by Torah the interpretation of the Torah text; a. fr.—בֵּית הַמִּ׳ (abbr. בה״מ) school, college.
<cite ref="Megillah 27a">Meg. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>בה״כ מותר לעשותו בה״מ</he> you may change a synagogue into a school house; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִדְרָשׁוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Keritot 13b:47">Ker. 13ᵇ</cite>. Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵇ top; (ib. I, 40ᵈ <he>מקריות</he>).

Gen. R. s. 42 בתי מ׳ school houses; a. fr.—Esp. Midrash, homiletic book. מִדְרַשּׁ רבה Midrash Rabbah, homilies on the Pentateuch (and the five M’gilloth) (beginning with ר׳ הושעיא רבה).—מ׳ חזית (from its beginning חָזִיתָ, Prov. XXII, 29) = מ׳ שיר השירים Canticum Rabbah; מ׳ אסתר Midrash Esther or Esther Rabbah &c.—מ׳ שמואל a Midrash to the Books of Samuel; מ׳ תִּלִּים, also שׁוֹחֵר טוֹב (from its beginning, Prov. XI, 27) a Midrash to the Psalms.—מ׳ תַּנְחוּמָא Midrash Tanḥuma, to the Pentateuch.—Pl. מִדְרָשִׁים Midrashim, esp. רַבּוֹת Rabboth (a plural of רַבָּה by false analogy).
